_rules: Every feature starts failing. Status changes ONLY via scripts/verify_feature.py after tests run.

features.title: Project setup, settings file, dependency record
acceptance: uv sync --locked succeeds; runtime deps pinned with ==; tzdata present
agent-lab --help lists chat and model
settings load defaults from agent-lab.example.toml; AGENT_LAB_PORT overrides the port
no user or drive paths in src, lessons, tests
every pyproject dependency is listed in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md

features.title: agent-lab model start|stop|status
acceptance: built llama-server command line matches the spec for the example settings
non-local host refused
missing llama_server or model path: exit 1 naming the setting and path
already running prints already running; port in use by another process: exit 1 naming the port
stale pid file: status prints stopped and removes it; stop when stopped exits 0

features.title: Model client on LiteLLM, no-network guard, scripted fake model
acceptance: chat() passes openai/<name>, api_base, placeholder key and timeout to litellm.completion
/no_think added only when thinking=False
connection refused, timeout and HTTP 400 become ModelServerDown, ModelTimeout, ModelError
socket guard in conftest blocks non-loopback connects; importing agent_lab.model passes under it
FakeModel and FakeChatModel replay a JSON script and record requests
default pytest run executes 0 live tests
features.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_model.py tests/test_fakes.py tests/test_network_guard.py

features.title: Lesson 01: model call
acceptance: lessons/01_model_call.py --fake exits 0 and prints agent> with the fake reply
module docstrings present in src and lessons

features.title: MCP server: math, units, date and time tools
acceptance: bad units and km->kg return error results naming valid units
days_between('2026-10-29', '2026-12-31') == 63 and reversed == -63; now('Asia/Kolkata') ends +05:30
bad date or zone gives an error result

features.title: MCP server: sandboxed notes tools
acceptance: write/read/list round trip incl. non-ASCII; second write says updated
../x, a/b, C:x, con, Com1, empty and 65-char names rejected; parent folder unchanged
10,000 chars accepted, 10,001 rejected; junction escape rejected
missing note returns an error result; missing folder lists empty

features.title: MCP server: docs search
acceptance: search_docs ranks the fixture doc first; absent word returns []
empty query or limit outside 1..10 gives an error result

features.title: MCP protocol test and lesson 05 (MCP client over stdio)
acceptance: in-memory client lists exactly the 9 tools and calls each once
lessons/05_mcp_client.py exits 0 over stdio and lists all tools

features.title: Tool bridge and lesson 02: tool call
acceptance: MCP tool converts to OpenAI tool format; check_args finds missing, unknown and wrong-type args
lesson 02 --fake prints [tool: multiply] and 391
second request has a tool message with the first call id

features.title: Lesson 03: structured output with one retry
acceptance: fake [bad, good] exits 0 with a card after 2 calls
fake [bad, bad] exits 1 with the error after 2 calls

features.title: MCP client, hand-written agent loop and run trace
acceptance: McpTools opens a stdio session, lists 9 specs, calls a tool, and ends the child on close
canonical task answers after 3 model calls with the defined tool sequence
wrong argument name, bad JSON arguments and unknown tool give error tool messages, no exception
always-tool model stops after max_steps model calls with LIMIT_MESSAGE
trace lines parse, have t and kind, t never decreases; same-millisecond runs get different files
features.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_mcp_client.py tests/test_agent_hand.py tests/test_trace.py

features.title: Lesson 04: agent loop
acceptance: lessons/04_agent_loop.py --fake prints 2 tool steps and the final answer

features.title: LangGraph agent
acceptance: same fake script gives the same tool sequence and final text as the hand agent
always-tool model stops with the same limit message
hand and graph traces have the same kind sequence

features.title: Lesson 06: LangGraph agent
acceptance: lessons/06_langgraph_agent.py --fake prints model, tools, model, tools, model updates and the answer

features.title: CLI chat with both engines
acceptance: two piped questions and exit give two answers, exit 0
no model server: clear message, exit 2, no traceback

features.title: HTML trace viewer
acceptance: loads a fixture trace, shows the right event count and the final text
zero network requests besides the page

features.title: Local-only check and README
acceptance: only localhost URLs in src and lessons
README names every lesson and links its diagram flow

features.title: MCP docs resource and explain_tool prompt (Should)
acceptance: docs://mcp-basics returns the fixture text; missing and traversal names give errors
explain_tool('multiply') contains the tool description

features.title: Live smoke tests against llama-server
acceptance: lessons 01-06 exit 0 on the live model, each under 30 s (1 of up to 3 attempts)
hand and graph agents give the canonical tool sequence live
model start, status, stop, status works live
configured model SHA-256 equals DEPENDENCIES.md
